2609.18680.title: HearInContext: A Benchmark for Implicit Context in Speech Recognition
2609.18680.paper_summary: Contextual ASR can benefit from semantic cues or from target words explicitly provided in the context. We introduce HearInContext, a Mandarin--English benchmark that pairs shared synthetic speech with assistant replies supporting different interpretations. The benchmark comprises 3,764 semantic test cases built around homophones. Implicit contexts exclude candidate words; explicit contexts name the target. No-context and unrelated-context controls measure the benefit of relevant history and sensitivity to irrelevant history. Context-capable models benefit from implicit cues but achieve higher target recall with explicit hints. Fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR-1.7B improves implicit-context target recall by 11.0 and 11.5 percentage points in Mandarin and English, respectively, while absolute CER/WER changes on AISHELL-1 and LibriSpeech remain below 0.1 percentage points. Gains extend to explicit conditions excluded from fine-tuning and to Mandarin hotword recognition on real recordings.
2609.18680.paper_summary_zh: 上下文自動語音識別（ASR）可以從語義線索或明確提供的目標詞中受益。我們介紹了 HearInContext，一個中英語基準，將共享的合成語音與支持不同解釋的助手回覆配對。該基準由 3,764 個圍繞同音詞構建的語義測試案例組成。隱式上下文排除了候選詞；明示上下文則命名了目標。無上下文和無關上下文的控制組測量相關歷史的好處和對無關歷史的敏感性。具備上下文能力的模型從隱式線索中受益，但在有明示提示的情況下能夠實現更高的目標召回率。微調 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 在普通話和英語中分別提高了 11.0 和 11.5 個百分點的隱式上下文目標召回率，而在 AISHELL-1 和 LibriSpeech 上的絕對 CER/WER 變化則保持在 0.1 個百分點以下。增益擴展到排除在微調之外的明示條件，以及對實際錄音的普通話熱詞識別。
